save_mesh_to_obj: save numpy vertex and face arrays to a Wavefront OBJ mesh file at the given path
get_all_files: recursively find all files in a directory matching an extension and optional keyword filter
save_pkl: pickle and save a Python data structure to a .pkl file, auto-creating parent directories
load_pkl: load and return pickled data from a .pkl file with automatic encoding fallback
analyze_path: parse a file path into its directory, filename, basename, and extension components
